description: CVEs affecting one open-source package, by purl (pkg:npm/lodash) or ecosystem + name (Maven names are group:artifact). Returns the CVE list KEV-first with each OSV version range VERBATIM: `events` plus one render-safe projection: `fixed` (the upgrade targets) or `affected_through` (the last VULNERABLE version, so upgrade past it). This tool does not evaluate version membership; compare versions on your side with your ecosystem’s own semantics. Covers CVE-linked, GitHub-reviewed OSS advisories via OSV.dev; absence is not evidence of safety.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem (npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, Packagist, RubyGems, NuGet, …) or purl type (pypi, cargo, composer, gem, golang, …)

name.description: Package name, verbatim (for example @babel/core or org.jenkins-ci.main:jenkins-core)

purl.description: Package URL, such as pkg:npm/lodash or pkg:maven/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core

name: query_package
